$comment: Suggested default constants from SPEC.md §10. ALL values are tunable and MUST be reviewed before launch. Copy to constants.json (gitignored) and adjust per environment.

token.$comment_totalSupply: TBD — set in Phase 0 tokenomics finalize.

ponsFee.$comment: Pons COLLECTS the trade fee — we do not levy it. Fee params are set per launch and read on-chain, snapshotted at launch and immutable. Confirm the real values on-chain (BLOCKERS.md #3). Below are our launch INTENT + the commonly-cited default for reference.

defaultReference.$comment: Pons default ≈1% total, 70% creator → ~0.7% of volume. To net ~3% of volume (creatorNetTargetBpsOfVolume=300) the total trade fee must be configured high at launch (≈430 bps). Tradeoff: high fee suppresses volume and is locked forever. See DECISIONS.md #5.

internalSplit.$comment: How WE split the USDG creator fees Pons pays us (keeps the spec's 2:1 auto-buy:marketing intent). Shares are of RECEIVED creator fees and must sum to 10000. Marketing may double as ops treasury — DECISIONS.md #1.

feeSource.$comment: Pons delivery (DECISIONS.md #5, BLOCKERS.md #3). mode 'push': enable Pons automation to route creator fees to payoutWallet (we designate it); 'pull' would call Pons' claim entrypoint instead. receive 'net': Pons keeps its protocol cut before we receive (we do NOT forward anything). feeToken 'USDG' is Global Dollar, Robinhood Chain's ERC-20 stablecoin — set feeTokenAddress to its on-chain address; the keeper swaps USDG to the Stock Token. Fill in payoutWallet before use.

cycle.$comment: 1 hour default. Keeper triggers auto-buy + convert + split each cycle.

reserve.$comment: Split 50/50. Drawdown thresholds are % of all-time peak reserve. High >60%, Low <20%.

hashRate.$comment: hash_rate = baseRate + (dripHeld^holdingExponent)*holdingMultiplier + taskBoosts + referralBoosts. holdingExponent is the anti-whale dial.

referral.$comment: 10% override, single level. Override does NOT reduce the referred user's earnings.

tasks.$comment: TASK_BOOST: +X hash for Y hours per task. Define per task type in Phase 2.

claim.$comment: Default none; consider 3600 (1h) to reduce spam txns.

chain.$comment: Robinhood Chain. EVM, Arbitrum Orbit. chainId verified on-chain (0x1237=4663). Native gas is ETH; USDG is the stablecoin. See docs/ROBINHOOD-CHAIN.md.

stockTokens.$comment: Official Robinhood-issued RWA/stock + base tokens on Robinhood Chain mainnet. Addresses + decimals VERIFIED on-chain via symbol()/decimals() eth_call (chainId 4663) on 2026-09-08. Do NOT mint your own stock token — permissioned issuance; you may only trade/LP against these. Confirm the full live list against Robinhood's registry API (https://api.robinhood.com/rhj/ metadata) + Blockscout before use, and re-verify at integration time.

USDG.note: Global Dollar stablecoin — base pair / fee currency
